name: KromiumMenuBuilder
summary: Declarative builder for configuring browser right-click context menus.

properties.name: context
properties.description: Contextual parameters and action helpers for the current right-click event.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Number of items currently present in the menu.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all existing default menu items from the context menu.

methods.name: clearDefaults
methods.description: Clears all existing default menu items (alias for Java / fluent style).

methods.name: removeDefault
methods.description: Removes a specific menu item by its integer command ID.

methods.name: addItem
methods.signature: fun addItem(label: String, enabled: Boolean = true, action: (KromiumContextMenuContext) -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Adds a standard clickable context menu item with an action callback.

methods.name: item
methods.signature: fun item(label: String, enabled: Boolean = true, action: (KromiumContextMenuContext) -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Kotlin DSL alias for addItem.

methods.name: addCheckItem
methods.signature: fun addCheckItem(label: String, checked: Boolean, enabled: Boolean = true, onToggle: (Boolean) -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Adds a checkable (checkbox) menu item.

methods.name: checkItem
methods.signature: fun checkItem(label: String, checked: Boolean, enabled: Boolean = true, onToggle: (Boolean) -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Kotlin DSL alias for addCheckItem.

methods.name: addRadioItem
methods.signature: fun addRadioItem(label: String, checked: Boolean, groupId: Int, enabled: Boolean = true, onSelect: () -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Adds a radio menu item belonging to a mutual-exclusion group.

methods.name: radioItem
methods.signature: fun radioItem(label: String, checked: Boolean, groupId: Int, enabled: Boolean = true, onSelect: () -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Kotlin DSL alias for addRadioItem.

methods.name: addSeparator
methods.description: Adds a visual separator line between menu items.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Kotlin DSL alias for addSeparator.

methods.name: addSubMenu
methods.signature: fun addSubMenu(label: String, block: (KromiumMenuBuilder) -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Adds a nested submenu with its own child builder.

methods.name: subMenu
methods.signature: fun subMenu(label: String, block: KromiumMenuBuilder.() -> Unit): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Kotlin DSL alias for addSubMenu.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Adds the native Back command.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Adds the native Forward command.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Adds the native Reload command.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Adds the native Print command.

methods.name: viewSource
methods.signature: fun viewSource(label: String = "View Page Source"): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Adds the native View Page Source command.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Adds the native Copy command.

methods.name: cut
methods.description: Adds the native Cut command.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Adds the native Paste command.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Adds the native Select All command.

methods.name: inspectElement
methods.description: Turnkey action: Opens DevTools targeting clicked element coordinates.

methods.name: copyLink
methods.signature: fun copyLink(label: String = "Copy Link Address"): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Turnkey action: Copies target link URL to clipboard if on hyperlink.

methods.name: saveImageAs
methods.signature: fun saveImageAs(label: String = "Save Image As..."): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Turnkey action: Triggers download for image/media under cursor.

methods.name: copyImageUrl
methods.signature: fun copyImageUrl(label: String = "Copy Image Address"): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Turnkey action: Copies media/image source URL to clipboard.

methods.name: searchWeb
methods.signature: fun searchWeb(labelFormat: String = "Search Google for \"%s\"", engineUrl: String = "https://www.google.com/search?q=%s", openInSystemBrowser: Boolean = true): KromiumMenuBuilder
methods.description: Turnkey action: Searches web for selected text.
